name: Retest linear fork integration
command:
set -e
VP=/workspace/t3code-pi/node_modules/.bin/vp
cd /workspace/t3code-pi/apps/server
"$VP" test run src/provider/Drivers/PiDriver.test.ts src/provider/Layers/PiAdapter.test.ts src/provider/Layers/PiAdapter.integration.test.ts src/provider/Layers/PiProvider.test.ts src/provider/Layers/PiRpcClient.test.ts src/provider/Layers/PiTurnUsage.test.ts src/provider/assets/pi/t3-approvals.test.ts src/provider/Layers/ProviderRegistry.test.ts src/textGeneration/PiTextGeneration.test.ts src/orchestration/Layers/ProviderCommandReactor.test.ts src/orchestration/Layers/ProviderRuntimeIngestion.test.ts
cd /workspace/t3code-pi/apps/web
"$VP" test run --project unit src/components/chat/ComposerPrimaryActions.test.tsx src/components/chat/ComposerPendingUserInputPanel.test.tsx src/components/settings/ProviderSettingsForm.test.ts src/composerDraftStore.test.ts src/lib/contextWindow.test.ts src/pendingUserInput.test.ts src/session-logic.test.ts src/queuedMessageStore.test.ts
cd /workspace/t3code-pi/apps/mobile
"$VP" test run src/state/thread-outbox.test.ts src/state/use-thread-outbox-drain.test.ts
cd /workspace/t3code-pi/packages/client-runtime
"$VP" test run src/state/compaction.test.ts src/pendingRequests.test.ts
cd /workspace/t3code-pi/packages/contracts
"$VP" test run src/provider.test.ts src/providerRuntime.test.ts src/model.test.ts src/orchestration.test.ts src/keybindings.test.ts
cd /workspace/t3code-pi/apps/desktop
"$VP" test run src/updates/DesktopUpdates.test.ts
cd /workspace/t3code-pi
"$VP" test run scripts/build-desktop-artifact.test.ts
PATH="$PWD/node_modules/.bin:$PATH" "$VP" run --filter t3 --filter @t3tools/web --filter @t3tools/mobile --filter @t3tools/desktop --filter @t3tools/client-runtime --filter @t3tools/contracts typecheck
"$VP" fmt --check .github/workflows/sync-upstream.yml
